name: The Minimum Project
source:
Hiroshi, an average if vertically-challenged student at Saisho Academy agrees to assist the science club president with one of her newest inventions. Something goes terribly wrong and he finds himself stuck at 1/100th of his normal height. Seek out someone to help you grow back while trying (or not) to avoid getting killed by unaware or malicious giantesses!

[From [url=https://interventiongts.itch.io/the-minimum-project]itch.io[/url]]
